title: 美中商业理事会Sean Stein：AI对话只谈安全，不谈国家安全？
speaker: Sean Stein

segments.en: Yeah, so there's a lot of I think misconceptions about this AI dialogue. I often hear, how can the two sides trust each other? Well, when you look at an AI dialogue or sort of cooperation between the two countries, there's really two parts. There's the security part, the national security part, and there's the safety part.
segments.zh: 关于这次AI对话，有很多误解。我常听到，双方怎么能互信？其实两国AI对话或合作有两部分：安全部分，即国家安全部分，以及安全防护部分。

segments.en: The national security part is how do countries use them to target each other? All of this sort of dangerous things, but that's not what the dialogue is about. The dialogue is about safety.
segments.zh: 国家安全部分是指国家如何利用它们针对彼此，这些危险的事情，但这不是对话的内容。对话是关于安全防护的。

segments.en: The dialogue is how do we ensure that both sides have guardrails on their leading edge tools? How do we notify each other when they are misused? And how do we make sure that bad actors can't employ these tools?
segments.zh: 对话是关于如何确保双方在前沿工具上有护栏？如何在使用不当时互相通知？如何确保不良行为者无法利用这些工具？

segments.en: And so that discussion on safety is enormously important, but it often gets conflated with the idea that they're going to talk about security, and I think there just isn't enough trust yet to get into the security realm.
segments.zh: 所以关于安全防护的讨论极其重要，但常被混同于他们要谈国家安全。我认为目前还没有足够信任进入国家安全领域。
